paite: TOUPA kiang ah ka lungtang tengteng in kipahthu ka gen ding a; na thillamdang hih tengteng ka theisak ding hi.
heading: Tapa Sihna Chih Kaih A Sak Ding. David La / Adikna Ziak A Pathian Kiang A Kipahthu Genna
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

paite: Nangmah ah ka kipak in ka nuam ding a; Tungnungpen aw, na min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

paite: Hon doute ataizaktak un, na ma ah akipalpuk ua, amangthang uhi.
english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

paite: Kei a dia kilawm himahleh ka thu ah nang kei na hon gum ngal a; diktak a vaihawm in laltutphah ah na tu a.
english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

paite: Namte na thuhilh a, gilou- saloute na hihmangthang a, amin uh leng tangtawn tangtawn in na thaimangta hi.
english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

paite: Dou mite amangbang vek ua, tangtawn a ding in bangmah nei lou in a-omta uhi; na kho sukgamsate amaute theihgigena nangawn toh amangthang hi.
english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

paite: TOUPA tangtawn in kumpipa in atu dia; alaltutphah vaihawmna in abawlta hi.
english: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

paite: Ama'n khovel kizentak in vai ahawmsak ding a, khentuam nei lou in michih vai ahawm ding hi.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

paite: Nuaisiahte a ding in TOUPA bukna ahi ding, buai hun chiang a bukna.
english: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

paite: Huchi in na min theite'n ahon muang ding ua; nang zaw TOUPA, nangmah hon zongte na paisan ngei ngal kei hi.
english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

paite: TOUPA, Zion a om phat in la sa unla; mite lak ah athilhihte hilh un.
english: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

paite: Sisan suah thu dongtel zelpa'n amau lah atheigige ngal a; migenthei kikou aw amangngilh ngei kei hi.
english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon hehpih inla; sihna kongkhak a pan hon kaikhepa, hon hote ziak a ka mangbatna en in.
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

paite: Nangmah phatna tengteng ka theihsak theihna ding in; Zion tanu kongpi ah, na hon hotdamna ah ka nuam ding hi.
english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

paite: Namte akokhuk bawl uah atum ua; aguk a alen zak uah amau khe mah a-awkta hi.
english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

paite: TOUPA akihilta a, vai ahawmta a; migilou-salou amah khutsuak mah ah a- awk hi. Higgaion. Selah
english: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

paite: Migilou-saloute Sheol ah akik nawn ding uh. Nam chih Pathian mangngilh hatte tengteng toh.
english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

paite: Tagahte mangngilh in a-om nilouh kei ding ua, gentheite lametna tangtawn in amang sam kei ding hi.
english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

paite: TOUPA aw, thou dih ve; mihing peuhmah vualzou kei hen; na mitmuh ah vai hawmsak in namte om uhen.
english: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

paite: TOUPA aw, amau lausak in; namte'n mihing lel ahi uh chih kithei uhen. Selah
english: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
